description: M/M/c queue: with N resources, how many people wait, how long, and what fraction leaves without a place. With `waitingRoom` the model becomes M/M/c/K (finite waiting area — the realistic case); without it the queue is infinite. Output times are in MINUTES. Erlang and M/M/c are exactly the kind of arithmetic a model does "from memory" and gets wrong.

avgServiceMinutes.description: Mean time one resource stays occupied, in minutes, e.g. 75.

waitingRoom.description: Waiting places IN ADDITION to the resources. Omit for an unbounded queue (nobody leaves).

name: queue_analyze
